title: MCP tools: import build, add doc, wiring answer
goal: NERV's fpv.import_build, fpv.add_doc and fpv.wiring_answer have a path through FPVBuddy
acceptance: MCP tools import a build and add a manufacturer doc (writes, with the F-012-T01 annotation so NERV gates them with approval) and answer a wiring question (read-only); specs cover each; the consumer tool table lists them
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
Owner data, export files and ID maps never enter Git

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: three tools on the F-015 core and the existing write pattern. Not a measurement.
